dialect.detail: Likely compiled with GnuCOBOL or similar open-source COBOL targeting disk-based indexed files; uses SCREEN SECTION with LINE/COL, ACCEPT/DISPLAY with AT coordinates, VALUE OF FILE-ID, and Decimal-point is comma (Brazilian Portuguese locale). Could also be Micro Focus or ACU, but the VALUE OF FILE-ID and ASSIGN TO DISK pattern is common in GnuCOBOL/older PC COBOL.

purpose.domain_detail: Asset/patrimony type registration system for a small company (SEMI-PARCAS CORP.), managing categories of assets such as furniture, electronics, IT equipment, and telephony.
purpose.summary: This program is a menu-driven CRUD application for maintaining a file of asset types (TIPOS.DAT). It supports inclusion, alteration, exclusion, and two types of consultation (by code and by description) of asset type records, organized by class and sequence number.

notable_features: Indexed sequential file (ISAM) with alternate key
VALUE OF FILE-ID for file naming
OCCURS table for month and class names
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: File decoded with latin-1 encoding; contains Portuguese characters (e.g., MARÇO). The IDENTIFICATION DIVISION header is missing (only Program-Id present without the division header), which is unusual but valid in some compilers. The program appears to be a student or small-business exercise for a Brazilian context. The EXCLUSAO paragraph has a STOP ' ' before PERFORM CONTINUA, which would prevent the continue loop from executing — likely a bug. Overall structure suggests a student project.
